description: Chintu aur Mithu ke saath milkar pyaare rang-birange gubbare gino. Yeh gaana bachchon ko 1 se 5 tak ginti aur rangon ki pehchan sikhata hai.
learning: Counting from 1 to 5 and identifying primary colors.
